_about: Olivia calling frequencies. A community convention, not a band plan - cited from the Olivia mode community page on groups.io as read 2026-09-14. 'center' is the center of the signal; 'dial' is the USB dial for a 1500 Hz audio center. The 8/250 spots are where calls start; QSOs move up and widen (see PHASE_PLAN.md R29).
source: https://groups.io/g/Olivia - Olivia calling frequencies page, read 2026-09-14
convention: call on 8/250 at the calling center; after contact, move up or down to a clear frequency away from the calling spot and change to a standard configuration such as 16/500 so the conversation goes faster
